The '''Festival Pavillion''' was the largest structure in the [[Alaphoe Gardens]] after the [[Glass Palace]]. The pavilion contained a large indoor theater for plays and [[Music/Legends|concerts]], a small dining room and ballroom that both look out over the [[Alaphoe Lake]].<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
